summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (private helpers _resolve_path and _resolve_value), exported it via an explicit import in monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry after the Utilities automodule in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Verification was by reading and measurement only: no test, black, or flake8 runs, per instructions. Measured no line over 120 columns in the four touched files. Nothing committed. Choices beyond the spec: non-object top-level JSON and non-list key values raise ValueError; items are copied, not mutated; missing image/label is skipped silently.
